description: Search recent public social posts for brand mentions, market demand, customer feedback, product needs, and emerging trends using keywords, language filters, and exclusions. Each request runs a bounded on-demand search and returns minimized JSON. It never accesses private posts, tracks people by identity, or runs continuously. Brand & Market Social Research is an independent Telemark Digital app. No external account, payment method, or purchase is required. Telemark Digital funds the free searches, subject to daily and shared monthly capacity limits.
